text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Japan Cup, a roar 
rumbled through the venue. Amid the stirs 
of the packed crowd—

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
I have descended! —Behold, absolute 
perfection and beauty. —Tremble in awe at 
this supreme majesty.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
Challenging the future "Overlord of the 
Century's End" is the candidate for her 
lifelong rival, the "Raging Dark Lord"... 
Doto.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
A battle with the pride of a king on the 
line. Onward to the Japan Cup—!
